Ovarian cancer usually has a relatively poor [prognosis](/wiki/Prognosis "Prognosis"). It is disproportionately deadly because it lacks any clear early detection or screening test, meaning most cases are not diagnosed until they have reached advanced stages.[[126]](#cite_note-SGOfive-126)[[29]](#cite_note-Jayson-29)

Ovarian cancer metastasizes early in its development, often before it has been diagnosed. High-grade tumors metastasize more readily than low-grade tumors. Typically, tumor cells begin to metastasize by growing in the peritoneal cavity.[[27]](#cite_note-Harrisons-27) More than 60% of women presenting with ovarian cancer have stage-III or stage-IV cancer, when it has already spread beyond the ovaries. Ovarian cancers shed cells into the naturally occurring fluid within the abdominal cavity. These cells can then implant on other abdominal (peritoneal) structures, including the uterus, [urinary bladder](/wiki/Urinary_bladder "Urinary bladder"), [bowel](/wiki/Bowel "Bowel"), [lining of the bowel wall](/wiki/Mesentery "Mesentery"), and [omentum](/wiki/Greater_omentum "Greater omentum"), forming new tumor growths before cancer is even suspected.

The five-year survival rate for all stages of ovarian cancer is 46%; the one-year survival rate is 72% and the ten-year survival rate is 35%.[[134]](#cite_note-134) For cases where a diagnosis is made early in the disease, when the cancer is still confined to the primary site, the five-year survival rate is 92.7%.[[135]](#cite_note-SEER-135) About 70% of women with advanced disease respond to initial treat

See also: [Kepler's laws of planetary motion](/wiki/Kepler%27s_laws_of_planetary_motion "Kepler's laws of planetary motion") and [Exoplanetology § Orbital parameters](/wiki/Exoplanetology#Orbital_parameters "Exoplanetology")

[![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/1d/TheKuiperBelt_Orbits_Pluto_Ecliptic.svg/500px-TheKuiperBelt_Orbits_Pluto_Ecliptic.svg.png)](/wiki/File:TheKuiperBelt_Orbits_Pluto_Ecliptic.svg)

The orbit of the planet Neptune compared to that of [Pluto](/wiki/Pluto "Pluto"). Note the elongation of Pluto's orbit in relation to Neptune's ([eccentricity](/wiki/Orbital_eccentricity "Orbital eccentricity")), as well as its large angle to the ecliptic ([inclination](/wiki/Inclination "Inclination")).

In the Solar System, all the planets orbit the Sun in the same direction as the [Sun rotates](/wiki/Solar_rotation "Solar rotation"): [counter-clockwise](/wiki/Counter-clockwise "Counter-clockwise") as seen from above the Sun's north pole. At least one exoplanet, [WASP-17b](/wiki/WASP-17b "WASP-17b"), has been found to orbit in the opposite direction to its star's rotation.[[61]](#cite_note-62) The period of one revolution of a planet's orbit is known as its [sidereal period](/wiki/Sidereal_period "Sidereal period") or *year*.[[62]](#cite_note-young-63) A planet's year depends on its distance from its star; the farther a planet is from its star, the longer the distance it must travel and the slower its speed, since it is less affected by its star's [gravity](/wiki/Gravity "Gravity").[[63]](#cite_note-64)

No planet's orbit is perfectly circular, and hence the distance of each from the host star varies over the course of its year. The closest approach to its star is called its [periastron](/wiki/Periastron "Periastron"), or [perihelion](/wiki/Perihelion "Perihelion")

Obanno entrusts Le Chiffre with $100 million to invest. Planning a terrorist attack on aerospace manufacturer Skyfleet, Le Chiffre uses Obano's money to [short](/wiki/Short_(finance) "Short (finance)") the company's stock.

In Madagascar, Bond destroys an embassy while capturing and then killing a bomb maker named Mollaka. [M](/wiki/M_(James_Bond) "M (James Bond)"), the head of MI6, chastises Bond for causing an international incident and ignoring her orders to take Mollaka alive. Information on Mollaka's phone leads Bond to corrupt Greek official Alex Dimitrios, who had hired Mollaka at Le Chiffre's request to bomb Skyfleet's prototype airliner. In the [Bahamas](/wiki/The_Bahamas "The Bahamas"), Bond seduces Dimitrios' wife and learns that he is going to [Miami](/wiki/Miami "Miami") international airport. He follows Dimitrios there and kills him, then chases down the new bomber Dimitrios had hired and prevents the destruction of the airliner. With Skyfleet's prototype secure, Le Chiffre's stock shorting scheme fails, losing over $100 million.

To recoup his clients' money, Le Chiffre organises a [Texas hold 'em](/wiki/Texas_hold_%27em "Texas hold 'em") tournament at the Casino Royale in [Montenegro](/wiki/Montenegro "Montenegro"). MI6 enters Bond—the agency's best poker player—in the tournament, believing a defeat will force Le Chiffre to seek [asylum](/wiki/Asylum_seeker "Asylum seeker") with the British government

List of highest-grossing animated films :: Timeline of highest-grossing animated films :: chunk_0019
At least 10 animated films have held the record of highest-grossing animated film at different times. Four of these were [Disney](/wiki/Walt_Disney_Animation_Studios "Walt Disney Animation Studios") films and three more by [Pixar](/wiki/Pixar "Pixar"), alongside three more by other studios. All of these films are American with the exception of *[Ne Zha 2](/wiki/Ne_Zha_2 "Ne Zha 2")*, which was produced in China.

*[Snow White](/wiki/Snow_White_and_the_Seven_Dwarfs_(1937_film) "Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937 film)")* held the record for the longest, with 55 years, while *[Inside Out 2](/wiki/Inside_Out_2 "Inside Out 2")* held it for the shortest period of 5 months. The original 1994 version of *[The Lion King](/wiki/The_Lion_King "The Lion King")* was the most recent non-CGI animated film to hold the record. *[Shrek 2](/wiki/Shrek_2 "Shrek 2")*, *[Toy Story 3](/wiki/Toy_Story_3 "Toy Story 3")*, *Inside Out 2*, and *Ne Zha 2* are the four sequels to hold the record. The 2019 version of *[The Lion King](/wiki/The_Lion_King_(2019_film) "The Lion King (2019 film)")* is the only animated remake to hold this record. *[Finding Nemo](/wiki/Finding_Nemo "Finding Nemo")* was the first 3D CG animated film to hold this record.

All of these films are still among the highest-grossing animated films except *Snow White*, and only *Snow White*, *Aladdin* and *Shrek 2* are not also among the highest-grossing films. *[The Lion King](/wiki/The_Lion_King_(franchise) "The Lion King (franchise)")* is the only franchise to hold the record twice. *Ne Zha 2* is the first non-American animated film, as well as the first adult animated film, to hold this record.

The first three films on this list utilize hand-drawn animation, while the remaining six are animated in CGI.

**Rev. John Andrews** ministered at [St. Peter's Episcopal Church (Lewes, Delaware)](/wiki/St._Peter%27s_Episcopal_Church_(Lewes,_Delaware) "St. Peter's Episcopal Church (Lewes, Delaware)") from 1767 through 1770. He then transferred to [York, Pennsylvania](/wiki/York,_Pennsylvania "York, Pennsylvania"), where assumed missionary jurisdiction at St. John's Church in York, [York County](/wiki/York_County,_Pennsylvania "York County, Pennsylvania") and St. John's Church in [Carlisle, Pennsylvania](/wiki/Carlisle,_Pennsylvania "Carlisle, Pennsylvania"), in [Cumberland County](/wiki/Cumberland_County,_Pennsylvania "Cumberland County, Pennsylvania"). Sometime in 1775 he took charge of St. John's Church in [Queen Anne's County, Maryland](/wiki/Queen_Anne%27s_County,_Maryland "Queen Anne's County, Maryland"). As the [American Revolutionary War](/wiki/American_Revolutionary_War "American Revolutionary War") progressed, Andrews grew conflicted: his political sympathies lay with the Americans, but he believed the oath of allegiance to England he took as part of his Holy Orders took precedence. He recused himself from public exercise of his profession and returned to York.

In 1776, during this period in York, Andrews founded the academy that evolved under several changes to become known as today the [York College of Pennsylvania](/wiki/York_College_of_Pennsylvania "York College of Pennsylvania").[[7]](#cite_note-7)[[8]](#cite_note-8)[[9]](#cite_note-9) In 1787 it was incorporated as York County Academy and brought under the jurisdiction of St. John's Episcopal Church.

After the [Revolution](/wiki/American_Revolutionary_War "American Revolutionary War"), Andrews resumed his clerical duties. On 13 April 1782 he returned to Maryland to become rector of [St. Thomas Church in Garrison Forest](/wiki/St._Thomas_Church_(Owings_Mills,_Maryland) "St. Thomas Church (Owings Mills, Maryland)"), [Baltimore County, Maryland](/wiki/Baltimore_Count

Focusing on its core brand, McDonald's began [divesting](/wiki/Divestment "Divestment") itself of other chains it had acquired during the 1990s. The company owned a majority stake in [Chipotle Mexican Grill](/wiki/Chipotle_Mexican_Grill "Chipotle Mexican Grill") until October 2006, when McDonald's fully divested from Chipotle through a stock exchange.[[98]](#cite_note-99)[[99]](#cite_note-mcds-dbj-100) Until December 2003, it owned [Donatos Pizza](/wiki/Donatos_Pizza "Donatos Pizza"), and it owned a small share of [Aroma Café](/wiki/Aroma_Caf%C3%A9 "Aroma Café"), from 1999 to 2001. On August 27, 2007, McDonald's sold [Boston Market](/wiki/Boston_Market "Boston Market") to [Sun Capital Partners](/wiki/Sun_Capital_Partners "Sun Capital Partners").[[100]](#cite_note-Chogath_Kog'sante-101)

McDonald's has increased shareholder dividends for 25 consecutive years,[[101]](#cite_note-ReutersOnMcDividend-102) making it one of the [S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats](/wiki/S%26P_500_Dividend_Aristocrats "S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats").[[102]](#cite_note-seekAlphaFullListDivArist-103) The company is ranked 131st on the [*Fortune* 500](/wiki/Fortune_500 "Fortune 500") of the [largest United States corporations by revenue](/wiki/List_of_largest_companies_in_the_United_States_by_revenue "List of largest companies in the United States by revenue").[[103]](#cite_note-104) In October 2012, its monthly sales fell for the first time in nine years.[[104]](#cite_note-105) In 2014, its quarterly sales fell for the first time in seventeen years, when its sales dropped for the entirety of 1997.[[105]](#cite_note-106)
